summary: Iteration 4 (login by identifier + PIN/biometric app-level lock). BACKEND: 15/15 NEW pytest tests PASSED (tests/test_login_identifier.py) — POST /api/auth/login accepts {identifier: <email>}, {identifier: <VAT 11-digit>}, {identifier: <CF 16-char uppercase>} and lowercase CF (normalized to uppercase); backward-compat {email: <email>} still works; wrong password for each identifier variant → 401; unknown email/VAT/CF → 401; missing identifier and email → 422; empty/whitespace identifier → 422; password<8 → 422; /auth/me with token obtained via CF login returns the same email. Full regression: 89/89 tests pass across test_fiskid_api.py (23) + test_multi_identity_wallet.py (23) + test_delegates.py (28) + test_login_identifier.py (15) — no regressions vs iter3. Note: previous test files (test_delegates.py, test_multi_identity_wallet.py) crash-on-import when EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL env is not exported — needs to be passed explicitly to pytest env when running from CI (already surfaced in iter3 context notes). FRONTEND: /login has label 'Email, P.IVA o codice fiscale', testID login-email-input, login-password-input, login-remember-toggle (default ON), login-submit-button, login-register-link, login-forgot-link — all verified. Successful CF login (16-char uppercase) → /set-pin (never /dashboard directly when no PIN). /set-pin renders 'Crea un PIN a 6 cifre', pin-key-0…9 + pin-key-back keypad; entering 6 keys → 'Conferma il tuo PIN'; non-matching PINs reset to step 1 (verified with 111111 vs 222222); matching PINs (123456/123456) show toast + navigate to /dashboard. /dashboard has dashboard-settings gear that opens /settings. /settings shows all required testIDs: settings-change-pin, settings-disable-pin, settings-bio-toggle (bio toggle rendered but non-functional on web — expected), settings-lock-now, settings-clear-remembered, settings-signout, settings-back; Login section displays remembered identifier value. Lock-now → /lock keypad; wrong PIN (999999) triggers red dots + toast; correct PIN (123456) → /dashboard. Ricordami persistence VERIFIED: after successful CF login and signOut, /login prefills login-email-input with the previously used CF. Toggling Ricordami OFF before the second login and then signing out results in an EMPTY prefill on /login (cleared correctly).

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping 'Esci e usa un altro account' (testID lock-signout) calls signOut() but does NOT navigate away from /lock. token/user are cleared in AuthProvider, however lock.tsx has no useEffect(() => { if (!token) router.replace('/welcome') }) and signOut itself does not router.replace, so the user is stranded on the /lock keypad with an empty email header. Spec says it should 'return to welcome'. Fix: in lock.tsx wrap the signOut Pressable in an inline handler that awaits signOut() then router.replace('/welcome'), OR add a useEffect in Lock that redirects when !token.

issues: Pre-existing RN Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (multiple), useNativeDriver missing (Animated fallback), props.pointerEvents deprecated. Non-blocking, carried over from iter1–3.

action_items: (HIGH) Fix /lock signOut to navigate to /welcome after clearing the session. Current code lets the user get stuck on the lock keypad with no way forward after tapping 'Esci e usa un altro account'. Recommended change in /app/frontend/app/lock.tsx: <Pressable onPress={async () => { await signOut(); router.replace('/welcome'); }} testID='lock-signout' /> — or add useEffect(() => { if (!token) router.replace('/welcome'); }, [token]).

(LOW) Consider a similar guard on /set-pin and /settings so that if the token disappears mid-session (e.g. token expired), the user is deterministically routed back to /welcome instead of relying only on /index root redirect on next reload.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py LoginIn: identifier Optional, email Optional (backward compat), password min_length=8 — correctly returns 422 for short password and 422 for missing both; 401 for unknown identifier / wrong password with the same message ('Credenziali non corrette') and DUMMY_HASH timing-equalization — good practice.
server.py resolve_user_by_identifier(): email path uses .lower(); VAT path matches exactly ^\d{11}$; CF path uppercases before matching; only active (non-deleted) fiscal_profiles considered. Correct.

src/lock.ts: SHA-256 via SubtleCrypto with a FNV-1a fallback documented as non-crypto — acceptable per spec (client-side PIN). SecureStore on native / AsyncStorage on web. rememberedIdentifier uses the same abstraction — good.
src/auth.tsx signIn(): after successful login, hasPin/unlocked are re-derived from pinLock.isEnabled() — correct behavior for cross-device state.
app/index.tsx routing: correct precedence (no token → /welcome; hasPin && !unlocked → /lock; !hasPin → /set-pin; else /dashboard).
app/lock.tsx: MISSING route-away on signOut. Only cleans token via context; no redirect. See HIGH bug above.
app/settings.tsx clearRemembered() calls rememberedIdentifier.clear() and refreshes state — verified working; toggling Ricordami off at login also calls .clear() — verified.
PinKeypad.tsx uses pin-key-{0..9} + pin-key-back + pin-key-bio testIDs (bio hidden with opacity:0 when no onBiometric provided) — matches spec.

set-pin.tsx: mismatched confirm branch: setTimeout 700ms clears both pin and confirm and returns to 'choose' step — verified. Matching branch persists PIN hash then navigates to /dashboard — verified.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all iteration-4 flows verified except 1 HIGH bug: /lock signOut does not navigate to /welcome)

seed_data_creation: Per-run ephemeral users: iter4+<ms>@fiskid.it (backend pytest, one per test module), iter4ui+<s>@fiskid.it and remember+<s>@fiskid.it (frontend Playwright). Each has one individual fiscal_profile with unique tax_code + one company profile with unique VAT.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest.ini keeps -n 2 --dist loadscope; iter4 test module test_login_identifier.py uses os.environ.get with a fallback URL so it does not require EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported (unlike test_delegates.py and test_multi_identity_wallet.py which still hard-require it — remember to `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=... pytest` if running the entire suite). Frontend testIDs to reuse on iter5: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-remember-toggle, login-submit-button, login-forgot-link, login-register-link, pin-key-{0..9}, pin-key-back, pin-key-bio (hidden on web), pin-dot-{0..5}, dashboard-settings, settings-change-pin, settings-disable-pin, settings-bio-toggle, settings-lock-now, settings-clear-remembered, settings-signout, settings-back, lock-signout, bio-toggle (on /set-pin, only rendered when bioSupported=true — always false on web). On web, expo-local-authentication returns false so the biometric toggle in /settings is disabled and setEnabled cannot be turned on — DO NOT count that as a bug. Direct navigation via page.goto('/settings') works and is a reliable workaround around the HMR duplicated-DOM issue on Expo Web when dashboard-settings click resolves to a hidden duplicate.
rca_of_issue: BUG /lock signOut stuck: lock.tsx binds Pressable onPress directly to signOut from useAuth. signOut clears tokenStorage and sets token=null, user=null, unlocked=false in the AuthProvider, but /lock is a leaf route that does NOT observe token; only /index (root) reads token and redirects. Because we are already on /lock, no re-render occurs that would trigger navigation. The screen therefore continues to display the (now-empty) PIN keypad with the user stranded. Reproduction: (1) register + set PIN + reach dashboard, (2) settings → 'Blocca ora' → /lock, (3) tap 'Esci e usa un altro account'. Expected: /welcome. Actual: still /lock (verified: URL remained /lock 2.5s after click; PIN keypad still visible). Fix: replace onPress={signOut} with onPress={async () => { await signOut(); router.replace('/welcome'); }} in /app/frontend/app/lock.tsx (or add useEffect on token to redirect).
